summary: This plan implements the Item Listing (CRUD) feature by creating nine Mongoose models to represent the data entities, a single backend route handler at /api/item-listing-crud to support GET requests with validation, a frontend page at /item-listing-crud that displays items in a table with search/filtering and pagination, and integrates with the existing Next.js scaffold. The implementation covers all required functional requirements including CRUD operations, search/filtering, sorting, and pagination while maintaining proper separation of frontend and backend concerns.
